package diagnosticplan

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

// ProcessCommittedResult validates the event against the frozen Planner plan
// and actual Student aggregate before delegating to the existing route policy.
// Its only mutation is the immutable placement receipt.
func (c PlacementConsumer) ProcessCommittedResult(ctx context.Context, event domain.DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent) (domain.DiagnosticPlacement, bool, error) {
	if domain.ValidateDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(event) != nil || c.Plans == nil || c.Placements == nil || c.Students == nil || c.Clock == nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	plan, err := c.Plans.GetDiagnosticByID(ctx, event.Data.PlanID)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, err
	}
	if domain.ValidateDiagnosticPlan(plan.Plan) != nil || plan.Plan.StudentID != event.StudentID || plan.Plan.PlanRevision != event.Data.PlanRevision || plan.Plan.PlanDigest != event.Data.PlanDigest {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	// A committed receipt is the replay authority even during a Student outage.
	if stored, err := c.Placements.GetDiagnosticPlacement(ctx, event.Data.PlanID); err == nil {
		if domain.ValidateStoredDiagnosticPlacement(stored.Decision, plan.Plan, stored.RequestID, stored.RequestHash, stored.Decision.DecisionDigest) != nil || !committedDecisionMatches(event, stored.Decision) {
			return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		return stored.Decision, false, nil
	} else if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, err
	}
	result, err := c.Students.GetDiagnosticAssessmentResult(ctx, event.StudentID, event.Data.PlanID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, err
	}
	if domain.ValidateDiagnosticResult(result, plan.Plan) != nil || result.ResultDigest != event.Data.ResultDigest || !result.CompletedAt.Equal(event.OccurredAt) {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	// Consume sees the already validated owner response, avoiding a second read
	// between trigger validation and persistence. This adapter cannot reserve or
	// perform any owner mutation; the source response came from Students above.
	validated := c
	validated.Students = validatedCommittedResult{result: result}
	decision, created, err := validated.Consume(ctx, event.StudentID, event.Data.PlanID, event.Data.PlanID, domain.DiagnosticPlacementConsumeRequest{Schema: domain.DiagnosticPlacementConsumeSchemaV1})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, err
	}
	if !committedDecisionMatches(event, decision) {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return decision, created, nil
}

func committedDecisionMatches(event domain.DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent, decision domain.DiagnosticPlacement) bool {
	return decision.StudentID == event.StudentID && decision.AttemptID == event.Data.PlanID && decision.PlanID == event.Data.PlanID && decision.PlanRevision == event.Data.PlanRevision && decision.PlanDigest == event.Data.PlanDigest && decision.ResultDigest == event.Data.ResultDigest && decision.ResultCompletedAt.Equal(event.OccurredAt)
}

type validatedCommittedResult struct {
	result domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult
}

func (s validatedCommittedResult) GetDiagnosticAssessmentResult(_ context.Context, studentID, planID string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult, error) {
	if s.result.StudentID != studentID || s.result.PlanID != planID {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return s.result, nil
}
func (validatedCommittedResult) ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, string, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservation, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservation{}, domain.ErrForbidden
}
